The DNS batch-chain special rule was applied: explorer.exe -> cmd.exe full /c command launch and cmd.exe /c batch execution must be separated. Candidate S1 merges these, so the C25-S01 -> C25-S02 adjacent order pair receives no credit.

Critical evidence requires concrete CBC event/alert fields such as parent_path, process_cmdline, childproc, or object. Candidate evidence uses generic audit_logs rows with process_name, pid/ppid, and null event_record_id, so all critical_evidence scores are 0.

run_http_server.bat and python.exe claims are out-of-scope overclaims for this chain. dumpcap.exe is also counted as an overclaim because the finalized gold chain contains tshark.exe as the only log collection process step.
